notes.title: Salvo Shuffle Minor Update V1.0.2
notes.content:
Salvo Shuffle version V1.0.2.0 released!

In the future, updates with a size similar to V1.0.1 will increase the second version number from the left instead of the third. So V1.0.1 would be V1.1 and this update would be V1.1.1.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gold Plating buffed.
[list][*] +2 shards per turn [was +1].
[*] Upgraded: -2 Strike damage [was -3].
[*] Upgraded: +3 shards per turn [was +2].
[/list][*] Cursed Heart buffed: -2 HP regen on Guard per shard [was -3].
[*] Poison Syringe upgrade buffed: Cooldown reduced to 2 [was 3].
[*] Soul Catcher nerfed: Price increased to 45c [was 40c].
[*] Focus Potion upgrade buffed: +2 shards [was +1].
[*] Overcharge buffed:
[list][*] Upgraded: Sets the miss chance to 15% [was 20%].
[*] Upgraded: Cooldown reduced to 5 [was 9].
[/list][/list]

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Curses now grant you 20 coins after beating a fight with them.
[/list]

[h2]Visual Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The victory screen now displays your collected augments.
[*] The victory screen now displays "EDITED!" if the save file was modified or developer mode was used.
[*] The name tag in the aquarium environment now has different texts depending on the player's cosmetics.
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] The speedrun timer will now pause during all cutscenes.
[*] The speedrun timer will no longer pause during hitlag.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Racket sometimes not spawning an attack or potentially moving weirdly.
[*] Fixed player overlay cosmetics not being visible in the credits.
[/list]

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Salvo Shuffle Hotfix V1.0.1.1
notes.content:
Salvo Shuffle version V1.0.1.1 released!

This update fixes two major bugs introduced in V1.0.1 that escaped my sight until literally 15 minutes ago.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the stamina buff space giving you an upgraded stamina buff instead of a temporary one.
[*] Fixed stamina buffs turning into agility buffs on reload.
[/list]

I'll see you in the next update!

notes.title: Salvo Shuffle Minor Update V1.0.1
notes.content:
Salvo Shuffle version V1.0.1.0 released!

A lot of these changes were added in response to feedback/suggestions from the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/J4mvAahm6J]Salvo Shuffle Discord[/url].


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new buff: "Stamina Buff".
[list][*] +1 shard per turn.
[*] Disappears after a fight.
[/list][*] Added upgraded "Stamina Buff". Price: 45c.
[list][*] +1 shard per turn.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased the active time of a spear by 0.2s for the first two salvos.
[*] Reduced the maximum count of bee hazards that can be spawned by a single Bee enemy to 5 [was 11].
[*] For the hard challenge preset, reduced the levels of "Attribute" and "Bankrupt" to 2 [were both 3].
[list][*] The hard preset is still >50 heat and therefore still qualifies for the achievement.
[/list][*] "Agility Buff" buffed (lol).
[list][*] -0.15s dash cooldown [was -0.1s].
[*] New: +1s invincibility duration.
[*] Upgraded: New: +0.5s invincibility duration.
[*] Upgraded: Price reduced to 20c [was 30c].
[/list][*] "Defensive Buff" buffed.
[list][*] +3 max HP [was +2].
[*] -1.5s salvo duration [was -1s].
[*] Upgraded: Price reduced to 30c [was 50c].
[/list][*] "Offensive Buff" buffed.
[list][*] New: +1 Strike damage.
[*] Upgraded: New: +1 Strike damage.
[/list][*] "Supportive Buff" buffed.
[list][*] +4 RP per fight [was +2 RP].
[*] Upgraded: New: +1 HP regen on Guard per shard (just like the normal version).
[/list][*] Bees from the second salvo of the Bee will now choose their random destination in a larger area.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now dash while running into a wall.
[*] You can now also dash with shift or ctrl.
[*] Can now no longer dash while dashing meaning the player will be vulnerable for at least 1 frame every 0.2s.
[*] Coins gained by the miniboss will now ignore combos.
[*] While owning "Amulet of Patience", skipped waves when there are no enemies left will now decrease the combo amount further.
[*] The "Right Heart" (auto-regen) will now try to do it's passive ability after the player received RP from the final boss or from empty waves instead of before. This means that gained RP will be used immediately.
[/list]

[h2]Visual Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cards displaying upgraded augments will now have a more detailed outline than their non-upgraded counterparts.
[*] Added a "2x dmg" indicator for the double damage challenge. If the challenge is set to lvl 1 this will only appear if the next hit will deal double damage.
[*] There is a new animation for starting the enemy turn: The camera will zoom in and most UI elements (except for keybinds and the salvo timer) will disappear.
[list][*] Although this will reduce the total amount of visible space, this will hopefully make reading attacks easier/less annoying, especially for the Racket salvo from above.
[/list][*] Also added more animations for the intro of a fight.
[*] Introduced more consistency between the agility icon and its meaning.
[list][*] The "Agility Upgrade" (the one that gives you more shards) has been renamed to "Stamina Upgrade". The animation now says "Stamina Up!".
[*] The "Agility Buff" (the one that increases your speed) now has a new icon that looks like a feather.
[*] The previous icon for the "Agility Buff" is now used as the icon for the new "Stamina Buff" for shards (see section "New Content").
[/list][/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added progress bars below each challenge in the main menu that indicate to what level they're set to.
[*] You can now flip cards displaying augments to display the upgraded/non-upgraded version.
[list][*] This feature will work for shops, chests, Firework City, and in the main menu during level ups.
[/list][*] Made it possible to select the augment list in Firework City.
[*] You can now scroll through the augments at the bottom during a fight.
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the lag spike when opening the customization menu for the first time after startup.
[*] Added an option for limiting the game's fps. The default is 165.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an exception when the player has more RP than can be displayed.
[*] Fixed an exception when the Unity Analytics fail to initialize.
[*] Fixed the current charge/cooldown icons during a fight going off-center if there are too many of them.
[*] Fixed the player being able to go out of bounds on low framerates.
[*] Fixed being able to open the pause menu during the fight intro animation or a scene transition.
[*] Fixed being able to open the pause menu at all times by opening the Steam overlay or unplugging the controller.
[*] "Overcharge" augment will now display the cooldown progress bar correctly.
[*] Fixed dashing into the wall with a controller redirecting your velocity to the side.
[*] You can now no longer buy an item if it would decrease your max health to 0 or below.
[*] Fixed not being able to hold down a directional button for automatic repeat presses while in the pause menu.
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Salvo Shuffle Hotfix V1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Salvo Shuffle version V1.0.0.3 released!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[/list]

I'll see you in the next update!

notes.title: Salvo Shuffle Hotfix V1.0.0.2
notes.content:
Salvo Shuffle version V1.0.0.2 released!

I realized that the game was too easy to complete, so these quick adjustments should hopefully make the game pose as more of a challenge.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decreased all coins gained by 10%.
[*] Decreased spawn cooldown of all hazards by 10%.
[*] Increased speed of all hazards by 10%.
[*] Increased the scaling of HP. A normal lvl 20 enemy will now be 37 HP [was 33].
[*] Decreased the delay between waves in most fights.
[*] Coin and heal spaces will now no longer be affected by global coin multipliers from challenges.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Potentially fixed two exceptions relating to the pause menu.
[*] Fixed hazards randomly despawning during the final boss.
[*] Fixed a bug relating to trying to respawn an object that no longer existed.
[/list]

Have a good one!

notes.title: Salvo Shuffle First Progress Update
notes.content:
Hey, what’s up, everyone? It’s time to start sharing some progress updates on my game, and for the first post, I've chosen the format of a Q&A.
Let‘s start with the thing you’re probably all wondering about.

[h3]Q: How’s the progress on Salvo Shuffle?[/h3]
A: It’s going pretty well. I've noticed my to-do list getting shorter by the week. However, the game is still not quite finished yet and I am already committed to releasing the game fully instead of only in early access, so I’ll still need some more time.
One thing I can say for sure though: I have seen a lot of other indie devs not being able to finish their game and being stuck in an infinite development loop for eternity. I can promise you that this won't be like that. Salvo Shuffle will see the light of day. The only question is: when?

[h3]Q: When (will Salvo Shuffle come out)?[/h3]
A: Likely in early 2024. 2023 is just not happening with the current pace; the game still needs some additional polish and gameplay depth.

[h3]Q: What’s happening to your YouTube channel?[/h3]
A: Trying to balance both game development and video creation at the same time is not easy. So for now I have decided to put all my attention into Salvo Shuffle first and YouTube second.

[h3]Q: How much content will Salvo Shuffle launch with?[/h3]
A: Before I answer, know that I intend to update Salvo Shuffle after release, especially if there's enough player engagement. So the only question is when I decide to hit the 'release' button.

Currently, a single run takes around 30 minutes (at least if you succeed). Doing a run with some challenges enabled is the real challenge and it might take you multiple attempts.
Achievements are another factor for 100% completion and some of those might require a lot of time and skill, like the achievement in which you can't use your primary attack for a whole run (I still need to figure out whether this is even possible).

So while there isn't a shortage of tasks, the game needs some more items to make the time spent on completion fun. I have some item ideas in mind and with the way the game is programmed it should be relatively easy to add those; sprites being the biggest problem.
As a roguelike deck-builder, Salvo Shuffle should be pretty replayable and I'm working to achieve that.

[h3]Q: How much will Salvo Shuffle cost?[/h3]
A: As stated on the store page, Salvo Shuffle will be completely free to play. I made this choice to prioritize reaching as many players as possible over making a tiny amount of money from less players.
However, I intend to release the OST on Steam as well, which might not be free. Given that the OST will be uploaded to streaming services anyway, it's more about creating an easy way to make a small donation.

[h3]Q: Where can I learn more about Salvo Shuffle and its development progress and get involved in it? How can I talk to you and the community?[/h3]
A: Discord is the primary platform to engage with me and the community. I have a still quite small [url=https://discord.com/invite/J4mvAahm6J]Discord server[/url] set up. It's a lot easier for me to share some screenshots or tiny updates there than on Steam and as soon as I get a few more members on the server I will start doing just that.

[h3]Q: What's left on your to-do list?[/h3]
A: The following list is not complete, but here are some highlights:
- Many more augments.
- Active augments with health/coins/etc. requirements or specific charging conditions.
- I'm having a lot of trouble implementing Steam Input. So far this has taken up more time than any other feature.
- Improving the challenge selection menu and potentially overhauling the challenge system entirely.
- Adding an ending cutscene after beating the final boss, along with a recap featuring statistics.
- An 'extras' menu featuring stats/achievements/etc.
- Simplifying the tutorial to only focus on combat.
- A mountain of tiny improvements that are faster to fix than to write down in this post.

What's written on my "to do after release"-list I'll tell you in another post.

[h3]And that's it[/h3]
I hope this post gives you a better understanding of what's happening behind the scenes. I don't want to leave you in the dark, but whenever I'm working on a YouTube devlog or similar I always think to myself that I should rather spend this time working on the game. I hope to change that in the future.
At any rate, that covers most of what I wanted to say. See ya on the discord server or in the next post.
